t: The Luceco Rechargeable LED Head Torch provides durable, lightweight, hands-free illumination for tradespeople and DIY tasks on site or at home. Delivering 150 lumens with a powerful 150m beam, it aids electricians and installers working in dimly lit areas. This head torch features five versatile lighting settings, including a dimmed courtesy mode, and offers activation via traditional switch or integrated PIR motion sensing. An adjustable headband ensures comfort, while the integrated battery provides up to 20 hours runtime, easily recharged with the supplied mini USB cable. Its impact-resistant ABS plastic construction ensures robust performance for indoor and outdoor professional applications.
